    if (!user) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'User not found' });
    }
    const imageData = Buffer.from(image, 'base64');
    const records = await FaceEmbeddings.createFromImage(id, imageData, 'cache');
    res.status(201).json(records.map(r => ({
        imageHash: r.imageHash,
        embeddings: r.embeddings,
        model: r.model,
    })));
});

    if (!user) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'User not found' });
    }
    await FaceEmbeddings.deleteByUserIdAndType(id, 'primary');
    const imageData = Buffer.from(image, 'base64');

    res.status(200).json(records.map(r => ({

        embeddings: r.embeddings,
        model: r.model,
    })));
});

static async createFromImage(userId, imageData, imageType) {
    const { getFaceEmbeddings } = await import('../modules/facial_recog/facenetClient.js');
    const faces = await getFaceEmbeddings(imageData);
    const results = [];
    for (const face of faces) {

            face.faceImage,           // Buffer of the cropped face
